explanation: Mark reachable prefixes and remember the previous boundary of their last dictionary word. Reconstruct a valid decomposition by following those boundaries backward, or return an empty list when unreachable.
timeComplexity: O(n³) expected worst case, including substring creation/hashing
spaceComplexity: O(n) auxiliary plus O(n) output characters
